body_text:
For complex $s$ with $\operatorname{Re}(s)>1$, the Riemann zeta
function is $\zeta(s)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}n^{-s}$. It admits a
meromorphic continuation to $\mathbb{C}$ with a single simple
pole at $s=1$. Its zeros at the negative even integers are
called trivial; all other zeros lie in the critical strip
$0<\operatorname{Re}(s)<1$.
